geometry.coordinate_frame: IMPTC local x east/y north, metres
geometry.position_reference: Provider track coordinates [x,y] projected to ground plane; no unsupported claim of foot-tip/body-leading-edge position
geometry.completion_target: First crossing of opposite semantic crosswalk end by track XY; confirmation requires >=0.12s continuously observed beyond it. This excludes any extra crossing beyond the provider crosswalk-labelled region.
geometry.method: 20 lateral bands, 0.2/99.8% axial endpoints, median3 piecewise-linear boundary; straight fit is diagnostic only; fixed before event reclassification
geometry.reviewer: Codex visual semantic/map/video geometry review 2026-11-09; not independent human survey
geometry.review_scope: Verified topological matching of three provider-labelled crosswalk end boundaries to the source map and multiview video; no camera metrical calibration or anatomical-point validation claimed
geometry.physical_reference_limitation: Provider documentation does not identify a specific anatomical point. Same provider track point is used everywhere; independent foot-contact GT is unavailable.

r_proxy.interpretation: annotation disagreement proxy, transferred to IMPTC as synthetic assumption; not detector noise
r_proxy.integration_noise_model: Gaussian with existing Train-fitted bias/covariance; does not claim to reproduce the legacy selected Student-t distribution
r_proxy.coordinate_transfer: SPD axes used as target XY axes; unvalidated transfer assumption
